blocks.text: Despite the challenges posed by her autoimmune diseases, Kris Aquino has remained dedicated to her work, saying it serves as an inspiration for her to continue healing. Aquino has recently been making frequent public appearances for her brand commitments, including a recent event for an e-commerce platform. Aquino documented her photo shoot for the said brand while also giving fans an update on her health through her Instagram page on Wednesday, Sept. 30. “I normally write very personal posts, but I had an appointment last night, in Makati Medical Center.
